mapper.insert: INSERT INTO score (student_id, subject, score, exam_date, exam_type, remark) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{subject}, #{score}, #{examDate}, #{examType}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT sc.id, sc.student_id, s.name AS student_name, s.student_no, sc.subject, sc.score, sc.exam_date, sc.exam_type, sc.remark, sc.create_time, sc.update_time, sc.is_deleted FROM score sc LEFT JOIN student s ON sc.student_id = s.id AND s.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sc.id = #{id} AND sc.is_deleted = 0

SELECT sc.id, sc.student_id, s.name AS student_name, s.student_no, sc.subject, sc.score, sc.exam_date, sc.exam_type, sc.remark, sc.create_time, sc.update_time, sc.is_deleted FROM score sc LEFT JOIN student s ON sc.student_id = s.id AND s.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sc.student_id = #{studentId} AND sc.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sc.exam_date DESC, sc.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM score WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND is_deleted = 0
